fichas.title: Design with vegetation
fichas.summary: Landscape planting should be planned as part of the overall spatial design before plant species are selected. Plant choice depends on form, colour, seasonal changes, site conditions and maintenance. The text also gives general planting quantities, plant-delivery and storage guidance, and planting-time advice.
